svg.title: Ledokhod — The Ice Goes Out
svg.desc: Spring ice going out on a wide Russian river at dawn: floes on a water plane at constant areal density, projected from a camera 12 m above the water, hazed with distance by 1 - exp(-Z/380 m), with a single bright open lead beyond the last ice. Procedural SVG by Dmitri S. Pravdin.
svg.text: the river at 12 m above the water, ice out to 620 m
floes drawn 190 haze(Z) = 1 - exp(-Z/380 m) haze(620 m) = 0.804
